note: Two students, Rabbi Yohanan ben Beroka and Rabbi Elazar ben Hisma, went to greet their teacher Rabbi Yehoshua in Peki'in. He asked what new idea had been taught that day in the study hall. They protested that as his students they could tell him nothing he did not know, but he insisted that a study hall is never without something new. They told him Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya had lectured on the mitzva of assembly: men come to learn, women to hear, and little children so that those who bring them are rewarded. Rabbi Yehoshua said they had held a fine pearl and tried to hide it from him. They then told him another teaching: God says to Israel, you have made Me one unique entity in the world, and I will make you one unique entity in the world.
